srList.sentence: All cases with an intensity score >=2 and tumor positivity >=20 were considered positive, as previously defined 12 The following primary antibodies were selected for use in this study, based on the IHC markers introduced by Dadhania et al. 12: KRT56 (MAD-000651QD) and KRT14 (MAD-005103QD) as basal markers KRT20 (MAD-005105QD) and GATA3 (MAD-000632QD) as luminal markers and desmin (MAD-001011QD) as a p53-like marker.
